summary: Public libraries rely on E-Rate funding to maintain internet access and services. Losing this support could lead to budget cuts and service reductions.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate support, libraries would face budget cuts
claims.evidence_quote: Without E-Rate support, our library would face the very real possibility of making harmful cuts elsewhere in our already limited budget simply to maintain internet service. That could mean fewer programs, reduced resources, fewer materials, or cuts to other services our community relies on.
